<translate>
<!--T:6-->
The '''Red Ribbon Army''' fields soldiers and robots that patrol the land around [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]'s villages and garrison the [[Special:MyLanguage/Red Ribbon Tower|Red Ribbon Tower]], which keeps spawning them inside its walls. They attack players and villagers alike. They also guard the Red Ribbon bases, whose commander starts the [[Special:MyLanguage/Red Ribbon Army Assault|Red Ribbon Army Assault]] raid.
</translate>

<translate>
== Spawning == <!--T:20-->

<!--T:21-->
Soldiers and robots are '''wild enemies''': out in the open they spawn under open sky, day or night, away from torches and other light. The [[Special:MyLanguage/Red Ribbon Tower|Red Ribbon Tower]], a Red Ribbon outpost found in most land biomes, also spawns them indoors in dim spots (block light 7 or less), and vanilla monsters don't spawn in it. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Bestiary#How wild enemies spawn|how wild enemies spawn]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures|Structures]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Red Ribbon bases == <!--T:27-->
</translate>
{{Main|Red Ribbon Army Assault}}
<translate>
<!--T:28-->
'''Red Ribbon bases''' are large army bases in the Plains, Sunflower Plains and Savanna biomes of the Overworld; find the nearest one with <code>/dmzlocate red_ribbon_base</code>. When you come within 80 blocks, a garrison appears: 16 Red Ribbon's Soldiers and 3 robots posted around the base, each staying within 12 blocks of its post, and the '''Red Ribbon Commander''' inside the headquarters, a named soldier with 150 health and 8 melee damage. The garrison shows the purple supervillain tint and outline and doesn't despawn. Killing the commander starts the [[Special:MyLanguage/Red Ribbon Army Assault|Red Ribbon Army Assault]] raid: five waves of soldiers and robots led by Colonel Silver, Sergeant Metallic, Ninja Murasaki, General Blue and General Black's Robot.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:22-->

<!--T:23-->
The [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] pits you against the army's officers: Colonel Silver in '''The Red Ribbon Army''', then General Red in '''Red Ribbon Headquarters''' and General Black's Robot in '''Officer Black's Battle Robot''', both at the Red Ribbon Tower.
</translate>
